manifest.summary: Run the locally installed upstream application with independent configurations, tasks and logs.

diagnostics.mxu_finish_action: The action after MXU finishes may affect subsequent queue work.
diagnostics.mxu_autostart_invalid: The automatic-run instance is unset, missing or has a duplicate ID. Use Edit configuration to select a valid instance, close the editor, then reload the plan.
diagnostics.maaend_auto_start_instance_required: No valid automatic-run instance is selected. Select one in MaaEnd, save it, then read the script configurations again.
diagnostics.mxu_autostart_missing: No automatic-run instance is selected. Use Edit configuration to select it for this bound user, close the editor, then reload the plan. The active tab is not an automatic-run target.
diagnostics.mxu_launch_owner: Enable the Launch game pre-task in the MaaEnd automatic-run instance, select the correct region and automatic launcher discovery or a manual Launcher.exe path. The host does not launch the game directly.
diagnostics.maaend_unknown_task_preserved: Unknown tasks and their settings are preserved.
diagnostics.maaend_launch_game_pc_pretask_required: Keep and enable the official PC game-launch pretask.
diagnostics.maaend_unknown_import_preserved: Unknown interface imports and their settings are preserved.
diagnostics.maaend_task_definition_missing: Some tasks lack supported definitions. Their configuration is preserved.
diagnostics.maaend_controller_default_used: The saved controller does not match. The first available controller is used; check the instance settings.
diagnostics.maaend_launcher_mode_unknown: The PC launcher mode matches neither Auto nor Manual. Check the launch pretask.
diagnostics.maaend_manual_launcher_invalid: The manual launcher path must point to Launcher.exe.
diagnostics.maaend_other_instance_schedule_ambiguous: Other native instances have enabled schedules. Check and disable the additional schedules first.
diagnostics.maaend_power_action_requires_host_policy: Disable the native power task and its controller overrides. Let the queue handle completion actions.
diagnostics.maaend_resource_default_used: The saved resource bundle does not match. The first available bundle is used; check the instance settings.
diagnostics.maaend_task_incompatible: Some enabled tasks are incompatible with the current controller or resource bundle. Check the instance selection.
diagnostics.maaend_retired_task_not_imported: The configuration contains retired tasks. Check them in the native application; their settings are preserved.
diagnostics.maaend_declared_import_unavailable: Some declared interface files were not found. Check the script directory.
